entries.title: Psalms 26:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; [therefore] I shall not slide.

entries.title: Psalms 26:2
segments: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 26:3
segments: For thy lovingkindness [is] before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

entries.title: Psalms 26:4
segments: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

entries.title: Psalms 26:5
segments: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 26:6
segments: ¶I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

entries.title: Psalms 26:7
segments: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 26:8
segments: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth. {where...: Heb. of the tabernacle of thy honour}

words.text: . {where...: Heb. of the tabernacle of thy honour}

entries.title: Psalms 26:9
segments: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men: {Gather...: or, Take not away} {bloody...: Heb. men of blood}

words.text: : {Gather...: or, Take not away} {bloody...: Heb. men of blood}

entries.title: Psalms 26:10
segments: In whose hands [is] mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes. {full...: Heb. filled with}

entries.title: Psalms 26:11
segments: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

words.text: But as for me, I will walk

entries.title: Psalms 26:12
segments: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
